name: Coffee
gaps: Parcels are CoffeeBackgroundLayers Parcels (SGRC) (https://www.sgrcmaps.com/alma/rest/services/Coffee/CoffeeBackgroundLayers/MapServer/2). Published acreage is filtered to 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 4929 rows; 4923 distinct parcel ids stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the geometry check.
Pass 2 enrichment is from rural-oz-pass2 csv (tax REST, sale HTML-only, owner HTML-only). GDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Pass 2 sale is HTML-only. Zero-filled SALE_VAL columns are not stored as a sale price, and qPublic was not requested.
Pass 2 owner is HTML-only. Owner and mailing were not copied from an HTML report.
Property-appraiser links are filled from the pass-2 template with each parcel id and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
